gates.reference: all trigger, program, amendment, asset, role-ledger, dataset-role, protected-access, roster, parameter-count, unit-identity, output-hash, and exact 1106-unit ledger checks pass

favorable when the selected A2-minus-A1 or A3-minus-A1 equal-domain LCB exceeds 0.10 dB, at least three stratum LCBs exceed zero, and no stratum UCB is negative; unfavorable when both primary equal-domain UCBs are at or below 0.10 dB

selected aligned spatial arm minus its deterministic within-scene shuffled signal map has equal-domain LCB above 0.05 dB, at least three stratum LCBs above zero, and no negative stratum UCB; unfavorable when the equal-domain UCB is at or below 0.05 dB

selected-arm two-observation scene correlation has equal-domain LCB at least 0.50, at least two paired-domain LCBs at least 0.40, and every paired-domain UCB at least 0.30; corresponding UCB impossibility is unfavorable

among baseline-PSNR-at-least-30 dB scenes, the selected arm versus A0 equal-domain mean LCB is at least -0.05 dB and the below--0.10 dB harm-prevalence UCB is at most 0.10; a corresponding upper or lower bound beyond either limit is unsafe

selected primary contrast below--0.10 dB prevalence UCB is at most 0.10 and, on severity-at-most-0.15 scenes, keep-supported prevalence LCB is at least 0.50; a corresponding lower or upper bound beyond either limit is unsafe
maximum distance from each primary contrast equal-domain or stratum estimate to either simultaneous interval endpoint

fixed_factors: the official ConvIR-B architecture, source, layers, Haze4K checkpoint, parameter count 8630665, and backbone weights remain frozen
all adapters are inserted after the final decoder 32-channel feature and before the final RGB projection
all adapters use z times one plus 0.1 tanh gamma plus 0.1 tanh beta, with a 4-to-16 3-by-3 convolution, GELU, and 16-to-64 1-by-1 convolution whose final layer is zero initialized

A1 receives spatially constant global means of A2 dark-channel, saturation, local-contrast, and gradient maps; A2 receives the aligned maps; A3 receives raw RGB plus luminance through the same four-channel adapter
all adapters use AdamW learning rate 0.0002, betas 0.9 and 0.999, zero weight decay, batch two, 256 crops, seed 20260803, and exactly 2000 optimization steps
training loss is Charbonnier reconstruction plus 0.1 edge fidelity plus 0.01 modulation regularization
spatial shuffle is an inference-only within-scene mechanism control and never receives a separate training budget
scene-level PSNR differences are clipped to [-0.25, 0.25] dB before equal-domain aggregation
Haze4K training uses only 600 training-role scenes; Haze4K evaluation uses 150 internal-development scenes
ITS and OTS evaluation use role unassigned_known_overlap_quarantined with allocation ranks 0 through 149 and remain separate equal-weight strata
NH-HAZE contributes all 55 historical-development scenes and cannot supply confirmation evidence
the original clear scene is the only independent unit; haze observations, pixels, crops, steps, and sequential looks are nested
no output image, checkpoint publication, array, raw prediction, feature map, action map, or per-scene GitHub table is permitted
intervention.matched_budget: three equal-capacity adapters, each trained for 2000 steps on the same 600 Haze4K training-role scenes; 505 development-only original-clear evaluation scenes with two nested haze observations in Haze4K, ITS, and OTS and one observation in NH-HAZE
intervention.primary_variable: inference-observable signal domain for equal-capacity final-decoder feature modulation
intervention.reference: A1 global-pooled physics sham for primary signal contrasts and A0 official ConvIR-B for baseline, fidelity, and tail-risk controls

primary_estimand.aggregation: two primary contrasts A2-minus-A1 and A3-minus-A1; average nested haze observations within original clear scene, clip each scene contrast to [-0.25, 0.25] dB, compute each of four stratum means separately, then average the four means equally; select A2 on a predeclared near tie

question: Do inference-observable spatial signals, rather than adapter capacity or global pooled haze statistics alone, enable an equal-capacity final-decoder modulation of frozen ConvIR-B that yields material, spatially specific, cross-observation repeatable daytime-dehazing utility across four development strata while preserving near-clear regions and controlling negative-tail risk?

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: The archived sequence-2 result proves a valid scientific FAIL for GT-privileged cross-observation local-error operationalization: the remaining bottleneck is whether inference-observable spatial signals carry transferable restoration-control information beyond equal-capacity global conditioning and dataset-specific difficulty.

decision_design.alias_structure: A0 identifies the frozen baseline; A1 identifies adapter capacity plus global physics statistics; A2-minus-A1 and A3-minus-A1 identify the two primary observable spatial-signal contrasts. Spatial shuffle is a within-scene inference control and is not aliased with another trained arm. Physics versus learned signal class is not interpreted as a factorial interaction because their input definitions are distinct bundled interventions.

arms.description: Official frozen ConvIR-B with no adapter.
Equal-capacity adapter driven by spatially constant global-pooled A2 physics maps.
Equal-capacity adapter driven by aligned dark-channel, saturation, local-contrast, and gradient maps.
Equal-capacity adapter driven by aligned raw RGB and luminance maps.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: The simultaneous equal-domain A2-minus-A1 upper bound is at or below 0.10 dB or aligned-over-shuffled specificity cannot exceed 0.05 dB.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The simultaneous equal-domain A2-minus-A1 lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB with positive support in at least three development strata and no negative stratum.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: The simultaneous equal-domain A3-minus-A1 upper bound is at or below 0.10 dB or aligned-over-shuffled specificity cannot exceed 0.05 dB.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The simultaneous equal-domain A3-minus-A1 lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB with positive support in at least three development strata and no negative stratum.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any specificity or repeatability gate is unfavorable, any safety gate is unsafe, or the selected arm has a negative simultaneous domain effect.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The predeclared selected spatial arm has material aligned-over-shuffled specificity, cross-observation repeatability, near-clear fidelity, bounded negative-tail prevalence, and supported keep behavior.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: A family of two primary contrasts by four strata uses simultaneous two-sided Bonferroni control; group-sequential success uses the frozen critical values 3.88, 3.16, and 2.74 at information fractions 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00. The same look-specific critical value is applied conservatively to specificity, repeatability, safety, and precision summaries.

boundaries.futility: At looks 0.50 or 0.75, stop scientific evaluation when both primary equal-domain contrast upper bounds are at or below 0.10 dB; write every remaining scene as a typed predeclared skipped unit.
boundaries.precision: At the terminal look, a maximum simultaneous primary interval half-width above 0.095 dB is inconclusive-only and cannot change any decisive FAIL.
boundaries.success: No early efficacy terminal is permitted; favorable evidence is decided only after the completed terminal look using critical value 2.74 and all frozen gates.
boundaries.validity: Any identity, role, integrity, roster, asset, protected-access, or exact completed-unit-ledger failure triggers the validity veto and an inconclusive terminal.

design_selection.decision_value: One shared four-arm route separates baseline quality, adapter capacity, physics-observable spatial information, and learned spatial information while using shuffle, observation, domain, and safety controls to discriminate all live explanations.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: Three predeclared balanced scene looks after one shared adapter-training phase permit early futility or near-clear safety termination and otherwise finish in one bounded development run.
design_selection.shared_setup: All arms reuse the official frozen backbone, one final-decoder insertion point, equal adapter parameter count, Haze4K training roster, optimizer, loss, steps, seed, evaluation rosters, scene grouping, and uncertainty implementation.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: Three adapters train for 2000 steps each and all 505 frozen development scenes are evaluated at the terminal look; the synthetic same-scale contract is capped at 900 seconds before scientific data access.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: A2 exceeds A1 by more than 0.10 dB on the equal-domain clipped scene mean with simultaneous support in at least three strata and retains aligned-over-shuffled spatial specificity.
hypotheses.falsifier: The simultaneous equal-domain A2-minus-A1 upper bound is at or below 0.10 dB, or aligned physics modulation cannot beat its spatial shuffle under the frozen specificity margin.
hypotheses.statement: Spatial dark-channel, saturation, local-contrast, and gradient maps contain local daytime-haze information that a matched adapter can exploit beyond their global pooled values.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: A3 exceeds A1 by more than 0.10 dB on the equal-domain clipped scene mean with simultaneous support in at least three strata and retains aligned-over-shuffled spatial specificity.
hypotheses.falsifier: The simultaneous equal-domain A3-minus-A1 upper bound is at or below 0.10 dB, or aligned learned modulation cannot beat its spatial shuffle under the frozen specificity margin.
hypotheses.statement: A learned RGB-plus-luminance spatial signal contains transferable local restoration information beyond equal-capacity global physics conditioning.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The selected spatial arm beats its shuffled control, has cross-observation repeatability at the frozen thresholds, avoids negative domain effects, protects near-clear scenes, and satisfies the predeclared keep and tail-risk controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Spatial shuffling preserves the gain, cross-observation repeatability is below threshold, a stratum has a negative simultaneous upper bound, or either frozen safety gate is unsafe.
hypotheses.statement: Any primary gain is caused by spatially located observable information that repeats across nested haze observations and domains rather than parameter count, global difficulty, or one-dataset concentration.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: NH-HAZE establishes a benchmark and spatially nonhomogeneous condition; it does not prove that either proposed signal or this ConvIR-B adapter is useful.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Spatially nonuniform haze is an explicit real-image dehazing condition that warrants region-sensitive evaluation.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The super-resolution result does not establish dehazing utility, the selected signal class, or safety on this project's datasets.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Spatial feature transforms can condition intermediate restoration features using aligned spatial side information.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: Dark-channel assumptions have known exceptions and do not prove that the four frozen physics maps predict local correction direction.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Dark-channel image statistics provide a physically motivated observable correlate of haze under stated scene assumptions.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The published method does not validate this adapter, these uncertainty surrogates, or the frozen tail-risk thresholds.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Observable uncertainty-related information can be used to modulate restoration behavior and motivate explicit risk-aware evaluation.
